in_marathi.name: Ikransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ikransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ikransh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ikra' (moon) and 'Ansh' (radiance or splendor). It is believed to evoke the celestial power of the moon, symbolizing enlightenment, wisdom, and the gentle nurturing nature of the lunar deity.
